title: Matched-n mapping ranks
description: Per map: the rank at +10% relative validation SSE refit at matched n = 4500 (filled marker, hollow marker is the unmatched production-split rank) and the log-log slope of rank versus training size with a bootstrap-over-seeds interval.

panels.left: rank at matched n = 4500 vs hidden width, one filled marker per map (seed min/max bars), arm as color, production rank hollow on the same x
panels.right: log-log slope of rank vs n_train per map, bootstrap 95% interval bars
